author: Cleo Abram
description:
Why does Antarctic ice look so… weird?

The ice most of us are used to is blindingly white, but under certain conditions ice can look BRIGHT BLUE. These stunning, rare features are most commonly found in glaciers and can take millions of years to form. But why so blue?

Subscribe for more!

#Antarctica #Science #BlueIce
title: Why Does Antarctic Ice Look So Weird?
